description: Use when get_program and search_programs do not find a brand's affiliate program: queues the brand's own program page for a maintainer to verify against the brand's published terms. Not instant: nothing is listed and no score exists until the terms are verified. A domain already listed returns its listingUrl instead; a domain already queued returns the existing submission. Send the brand's own program or partners page, never a network or review site. Never invent terms. Then call get_submission_status with the returned id.

contact.description: Optional email for the person submitting; never shown publicly and never returned by any tool

name.description: Brand or program name, up to 100 characters

note.description: Optional note for the maintainer, up to 1000 characters

programUrl.description: https:// link to the affiliate or partner program page on the brand's own website

termsUrl.description: https:// link to the page that states the program's terms, when it is a different page

name: submit_program

createdAt.description: When the submission was made, ISO 8601

duplicate.description: True when this domain was already in the queue; the existing submission is returned

id.description: Submission id for get_submission_status; omitted when the domain is already listed

listingUrl.description: The program's page on openaffiliate.dev when it is listed

reason.description: Why a submission was rejected, in one sentence

reportUrl.description: The program's OAS report when it is scored

status.description: queued: waiting for a maintainer; verifying: terms being checked on the brand's own page; listed: on OpenAffiliate; rejected: see reason

statusUrl.description: REST URL that returns this submission's status

updatedAt.description: When its status last changed, ISO 8601

title: Submit Program
